recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR source follow-up is needed unless future rendering drops the inherited ancestor-elements row from resource tree views.
issue_request: FHIR-11224 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the DSTU2 ValueSet page. The reporter expected ValueSet.id in the representations; the final decision was to address general confusion by listing inherited Resource and DomainResource fields at the top of tree views, similar to XML and JSON views, rather than making a ValueSet-specific source change.
initial_application: The Jira comments record an SVN application note, but local git maps the cited build@10941 revision to unrelated Task changes. The relevant historical implementation is git-svn commit 704ad94007bf29524c4d248945ecebae4bb8f957 from 2017-02-26, which introduced XML/JSON templates and added the "Elements defined in Ancestors" rendering text to the structure table generator.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini, and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml is a differential specialization, so inherited fields should remain inherited from the base definitions and be displayed by the renderer. The current build.fhir.org ValueSet Structure tab shows the requested ancestor-elements list. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision or discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. Adding ValueSet.id to the ValueSet differential would be semantically wrong because id is inherited from Resource, and the current rendered tree view already satisfies the clarification request.
